class.name: MIDIEventMeta
class.description:
MIDIEventMeta represents a metadata event stored in a Standard MIDI File track. Metadata events contain information about the sequence or track, such as its name, lyrics, markers, tempo, time signature, and key signature.
The event_type property identifies the metadata type, and data contains the decoded metadata payload. event_data_length indicates the number of payload bytes stored in data.
The meta_data field stores additional decoded information for selected metadata types. Text-based metadata is converted to a string. Time signatures and key signatures are represented as dictionaries, and end-of-track events set meta_data to true. Other metadata types retain their payload in data without additional interpretation.
Tempo metadata is not converted into a playback tempo value by this class. Consumers such as [MIDIPlayer] are responsible for interpreting tempo changes during playback.

members.member: The type of metadata event, identified by its MIDI metadata type byte.
The metadata payload, excluding the metadata status byte, type byte, and encoded payload length.
The number of payload bytes stored in [member data].

constants.constant: Marker metadata identifying a point in the sequence.
Tempo metadata. Its payload conventionally contains a three-byte value specifying microseconds per quarter note.
Time signature metadata. The decoded dictionary contains the numerator, denominator, clocks per metronome click, and number of 32nd notes per quarter note.
Key signature metadata. The decoded dictionary contains the number of sharps or flats and whether the key is major or minor.
